overview: EduAI is a sovereign, end-to-end K-12 AI education platform built for every student — especially those in forgotten, under-resourced schools. It provides a fully free, non-commercial, self-contained AI study companion that follows students from kindergarten through graduation, with all intelligence, memory, and storage native to the platform. No external AI, no commercial APIs, no platform lock-in. Every student's achievements are permanently recorded. Every teacher gets real-time intelligence. Every principal sees their school clearly. EDDI — EduAI's unified self-thinking intelligence model — powers everything.
features: EDDI unified intelligence model with 7 adaptive modes and live passport narration
7 role-based portals: Student, Teacher, Principal, IT, Parent, Counselor, District
Full glassmorphism UI with PHI/Fibonacci geometry and OKLCH color system
Recognition pipeline: RCGN flags students, NOMS auto-generates nominations, ACHV seals achievements permanently
Self-Study Creator with Diego Protocol — Fibonacci backward milestone prep for UIL/CTE/Skills USA competitions
University with PHI-gated courses across Academics, CTE, Music, Athletics
Live Intelligence Layer driving UI layout states (CALM/STANDARD/ACTIVE/FLOW) via IAS formula
K-12 Achievement Timeline — every recognition event from kindergarten through graduation
Real-time Principal heatmap with live class mastery metrics and RCGN stream
Elastic Fibonacci Scheduling for students with tight schedules
Sovereign Vision Document with funding tracker and Diego Protocol case study
Feedback AI — sovereign, self-healing, logs to IT portal
